Mail domain and Resend credentials, or an operator for the outbox
A tested backup and restore procedure for database, Auth and private files
A Kazakhstan data-residency decision before real personal data is used
A real pilot company, supplier and bank-transfer operator
An external scheduler or pg_cron for the protected outbox and learning jobs
Run the manual strict release gate (release.yml, strict=true, ready_url=<deployment>) after deployment
